Frequently asked questions

Which lunar calendars are supported?

Vietnamese, Chinese, Korean and Japanese lunar calendars, plus Hijri (Islamic) and Jalali (Persian).

Can I get reminders for lunar dates?

Yes, with Premium: add events on lunar dates and get advance reminders before they arrive. The free plan includes up to 3 events.

Can I export my events?

Yes, Premium lets you export events to an .ics file to back them up or import elsewhere.

Which languages are available?

More than 10 languages, including English and Vietnamese.
